name: Lanterns Below the Falling Sky
introDiscord:
"Stars fall through the water like snow as glowing Starstone Lanternfish drift between shattered terraces. Some of the lights are stars. Some are fish. Telling the difference appears to be part of the adventure."

---------------- ROOM 1 — APPROACH ----------------
introTwitch:
"Stars fall through the water like snow as glowing Starstone Lanternfish drift between shattered terraces. Some of the lights are stars. Some are fish. Telling the difference appears to be part of the adventure."

---------------- ROOM 1 — APPROACH ----------------

lanterns-below-the-falling-sky-approach.prompt: Dozens of tiny lights hover between fractured starstone ledges. Three paths descend through them, although several 'stars' suspiciously blink when you look away.

left.message:
One particularly beautiful star suddenly opens a mouth full of teeth.

Starstone Lanternfish.

Apparently the sky bites here.

right.message: A meteor-iron container lies wedged beneath fallen starstone. Several Lanternfish are staring at it but seem disappointed by its complete lack of edibility.

forward.message: A sheltered pool glows beneath a dormant fragment. Shizuki left a bottle nearby labeled: "Lanternfish tonic. Contains zero Lanternfish. The name was misleading so I am clarifying."
forward.fullHpMessage:
"Shizuki's Lanternfish tonic remains untouched. You're already healthy, which means you can continue wondering why she needed to clarify the ingredients."

---------------- ROOM 2 — DEPTHS ----------------

lanterns-below-the-falling-sky-depths.prompt: The trench grows darker until the Lanternfish become indistinguishable from the falling lights overhead. Three routes disappear beneath a glittering false sky.

left.message: A cometglass seam has cracked open, revealing Star Candies sparkling between the shards. For once, none of the sparkles have teeth.

right.message:
A cluster of stars drifts aside.

One stays behind.

It opens its mouth.

You are beginning to develop trust issues with astronomy.

forward.message:
"A Berry sits beneath Shizuki's abandoned star chart. Every Lanternfish-shaped mark has been aggressively circled.

A note reads: "New navigation rule: if the constellation bites you, it is not a constellation.""

---------------- ROOM 3 — THRESHOLD ----------------

lanterns-below-the-falling-sky-threshold.prompt: Near the Fallen Lantern Basin, orbiting fragments bend the surrounding light into three paths. Lanternfish drift among them like pieces of a broken constellation.

left.message: Shizuki built a tiny resting nook beneath several orbiting fragments. Her remaining tonic reads: "For injuries caused by fish, falling stars, or confusing one for the other."
left.fullHpMessage: The tonic can remain beneath the orbiting fragments. Somehow you've reached this point without requiring Shizuki's emergency astronomy medicine.

right.message: A buried star-chart coffer opens beneath the luminous silt. Someone has drawn tiny angry faces beside every Lanternfish symbol.

forward.message:
"The final constellation ahead rearranges itself.

Two stars become eyes.

A third becomes teeth.

Yep. Fish again."

---------------- BOSS — FALLEN LANTERN BASIN ----------------

boss-antechamber.name: Fallen Lantern Basin
boss-antechamber.prompt: Thousands of lights gather beyond the basin. One by one, the ordinary Lanternfish scatter until only a single enormous glow remains.

bossPromptDiscord:
The false star drifts closer.

Its light expands across the entire basin while something enormous moves behind it.

Whatever has been pretending to be the brightest star down here has finally noticed you.

Use /yes to approach the Fallen Lantern Basin or /no to retreat before the 'star' gets hungry.
bossPromptTwitch:
The false star drifts closer.

Its light expands across the entire basin while something enormous moves behind it.

Whatever has been pretending to be the brightest star down here has finally noticed you.

Use !yes to approach the Fallen Lantern Basin or !no to retreat before the 'star' gets hungry.
bossRetreatText: You back away from the basin. The enormous false star continues glowing behind you. Several smaller Lanternfish immediately resume pretending to be innocent celestial objects.

boss.revealText:
The brilliant lure swings aside and an enormous jaw surges from the darkness.

Meteor-Lure Angler reveals itself!

completionText:
"The Meteor-Lure Angler disappears into the dark.

The remaining Lanternfish return to the water above like tiny stars.

You still don't trust any of them."
